comment: Death By Audio Rooms-inspired multi-mode stereo reverberator. One reverb core (Freeverb-style comb+allpass) with 6 blendable characters selected by Mode: ROOM/DIGIT/PEAK/GATE/WAVE/GONG. Freq/Depth are reinterpreted per mode. Mode selection is branchless (no switch -> no jump table -> no freeze).
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 0x01D8. Gain-structure fix (was inaudibly quiet). Bumped from 471 so the pedal loads the fixed binary fresh.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: params[5]. Reverb character: 0-16 ROOM, 17-33 DIGIT, 34-50 PEAK, 51-66 GATE, 67-83 WAVE, 84-100 GONG.

params.name: Freq
params.comment: params[7]. Per-mode frequency parameter (damping / crush-rate / filter freq / gate-time / LFO rate / gong pitch).

params.name: Depth
params.comment: params[8]. Per-mode depth parameter (size / bit-depth / resonance / threshold / mod depth / regen).

params.name: Mix
params.comment: params[9]. Dry/wet. Default 40 so it's audible on load (custom effects read params as 0 until a knob is touched, so this default is the on-load value). Push it up; high mix + high Time/Depth lets PEAK/GONG self-oscillate.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
